_comment: Stage 1 of the G1-v2 plan: the cardinality-aware card1 encoder. Fixed and
committed before any Stage 1 run. src/models/compare_g1v2_verdict.py reads
every run against this file and refuses a run whose design does not match
it. Every key is required; an unknown key is rejected rather than ignored.

design.reference: B1-card1 retrained at the same fixed budget: reports/fixed_budget/card1/b1_card1/fixed10000_seed42

criteria._comment: All four must hold. Any failure is reported as negative_result_stands; seeds are never re-drawn.
criteria.a_beats_b1_card1: Primary encoder seed: the 95% paired-bootstrap CI (10,000 resamples) on PR-AUC(G1-v2) - PR-AUC(B1-card1) lies entirely above zero.
criteria.b_beats_width_null: Primary encoder seed: the 95% paired-bootstrap CI on PR-AUC(G1-v2) - PR-AUC(the same block permuted within each split) lies entirely above zero.
criteria.c_leakage_gate: Every encoder seed: informativeness_gap parity holds (train minus validation probe ROC-AUC at most 0.02) and cross_fit_provenance is sound.
criteria.d_sign_consistent: Every encoder seed: the observed PR-AUC delta against B1-card1 is positive.

stage2_gate.directional_win: Stage 2 may start only if the mean observed PR-AUC delta against B1-card1 across the encoder seeds is positive. Stage 0 Track A's condition (a relation whose fraud_neighbor_lift beats card1's) is already met by device_info and device_fingerprint.

diagnostics._comment: Reported beside the verdict; neither can change it.
diagnostics.partition_alignment: Standardised train-vs-validation mean gap per embedding column, reported in every seed's leakage gate to confirm the shared initialisation removed the unaligned-basis defect of the earlier cross-fitted control.
diagnostics.count_blind_attribution: The primary seed re-run with every count input zeroed. Runs only if all four criteria pass; it attributes a win to the count inputs rather than to the embedding alone.
